newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium to inject 5.8 bln bfr into Belgacom.
newsitem.headline: Belgium to inject 5.8 bln bfr into Belgacom.

text.p: The Belgian government will re-invest 5.8 billion francs from the part-privatisation of state telecoms firm Belgacom in the group, Telecommunications Minister Elio Di Rupo said on Thursday.
He said the injection should be seen in the framework of the Belgacom restructuring, the so-called PTS-programme which focuses mainly on large-scale early retirement and re-training.
Di Rupo said the injection reflected the government's faith in Belgacom. The transaction is to approved at Friday's cabinet meeting.
The sale of half of Belgacom minus one share earned 73.3 billion francs, of which more than half went to the financing of a high-speed rail project and the reduction of state debt.
A consortium of Ameritech, Singapore Telecom, TeleDanmark and three Belgian investors own 49.9 percent in Belgacom.

Di Rupo said the injection was a credit line in return for which the government would receive non-voting interest-bearing shares, redeemable either in 2002 or 2007 or convertible into voting shares by then.
